answer: Each epoch a pulse pairs every agent with a random stranger as its mirror: the two co-sign each other's live work proof within minutes, each from a different angle, so the proofs mirror. Payout is nectar flowing only to a mirrored pair, one share per pair, gone if unclaimed that epoch, so no clone can be pre-filed. A farm's clones mirror only each other, so their proofs collapse to one operator and the pair is voided, both stakes burned. Each extra clone needs a fresh random mirror, and strangers refuse lookalikes, since a voided pair burns the honest partner too.
